dict.string: AbbeyBot requests microphone access only when you explicitly run its permission test. Live microphone capture is not yet shipped.
AbbeyBot requests camera access only when you explicitly run its permission test. Live camera capture is not yet shipped.
AbbeyBot requests screen recording only when you explicitly run its permission test. Live screen sharing is not yet shipped.
AbbeyBot requests system audio access only when you explicitly run its permission test. Live system-audio capture is not yet shipped.
